**Beta.** HACS only offers it if you enable beta versions for Awtrix Studio (⋮ → Redownload → Show beta versions).

### New since 0.12.0b2
- **The clock's own icons show in the panel on AWTRIX NG too.** An app whose icon is a file stored on an AWTRIX NG clock, like `co2`, used to show no icon in the panel. It now shows on the app cards, on the simulated screen and next to the icon field. On a TC002, a 16 × 16 icon is drawn at its full size, in a one-line app as in a layout.
- **Animated LaMetric icons are stored on AWTRIX NG clocks.** As on AWTRIX 3, Awtrix Studio drops them into the clock's icons once, so they no longer travel with every update of the app.

### Fixed
- **The colors of the entities on one line.** On AWTRIX 3, a line of several entities showed all of them in the same color: each entity now keeps its own, also when its color follows a gradient.
- **Icons on AWTRIX NG before 1.2.** These versions could not read the icons sent along with an app (the clock's log said `inline icon is not a JPEG the decoder can read`). Awtrix Studio now reads the clock's version and sends icons in the form it takes. Updating the clock to AWTRIX NG 1.2 or newer is still recommended: animated icons only play inline from 1.2 on.
- A deprecation warning of Home Assistant about looking up the clock's device.

### Layouts on the TC002 (from 0.12.0b1 and 0.12.0b2)
On a TC002 running AWTRIX NG, a simple app can use the whole 52 × 16 screen, one LED per pixel, instead of one line at double size: **Value**, **Title and value**, **Value and progress bar**, or **Two entities, one per line**, with a choice of legible fonts. The icon is optional, and a gallery icon is drawn at 16 × 16.

Existing apps keep working as they are. There is nothing to change after updating.

### Thanks
Thank you to [u/dyabolikarl](https://www.reddit.com/user/dyabolikarl) for reporting the colors of a line and the missing icons, and to korruptcow for the clock's log that showed where the icons went wrong.
